conbody.p: Summary, a project's own Home, is the project at a glance; the workspace's Home, at the top of the rail, gathers the same for every project. Along the top are its figures: how many artifacts it holds, the share of requirements that are traced (a test case verifies them) and verified, and how many fail their tests. Beside the project's name are its last baseline and the number of members.
Needs you lists what waits on the team. Click a line to open the artifact it names; the button on the right says what it does. Review all in its header opens the Review Queue.

ul.li: approve: an artifact in review; Review opens it.
suspect: a link whose ends changed after it was made. ✓ confirms the link still holds and ✗ removes it, after you confirm, right there on Home; the line leaves the list.
test run: a run still in progress, with how many test cases are left.
failing: a test case whose last result is a fail, and the requirements it verifies.
comment: a recent comment on an artifact; Open opens the artifact with its notes showing.

conbody.p: The Audit trail shows the newest events of the project, who did what to which artifact; click one to open what it is about. Full history opens the Activity page. Projects lists your workspace's projects with how far each is traced and verified, and when agents have proposed changes, a card counts the proposals waiting and opens the agent runs to review them.
On a phone, Home shows the figures as four tiles, then Needs you, the proposals and the recent activity.
